name: XDX Swap
rootCause: The XDX Swap (DDEX) on the Heco chain's cross-chain decentralized exchange DDEX was attacked. The attacker made a profit of 85.17 ETH (approximately $176,000) and cross-chained it to Ethereum. The DDEX code appears to have a backdoor. With the support and cooperation of DDEX, Star Labs, and HECO White Hat Security Alliance, XDX Swap has successively recovered most of the funds involved in this attack, with a total value of more than 5 million US dollars.

descriptions.text: The XDX Swap (DDEX) on the Heco chain's cross-chain decentralized exchange DDEX was attacked. The attacker made a profit of 85.17 ETH (approximately $176,000) and cross-chained it to Ethereum. The DDEX code appears to have a backdoor. With the support and cooperation of DDEX, Star Labs, and HECO White Hat Security Alliance, XDX Swap has successively recovered most of the funds involved in this attack, with a total value of more than 5 million US dollars.

XDX Swap on Huobi Eco Chain was exploited on 2021-07-02, with secondary reporting converging on about 85.17 ETH, roughly $176,000, taken through a bridge logic flaw and bridged to Ethereum. A bridge logic flaw in the DDEX or XDX Swap cross-chain contract, described in secondary reporting as a suspected backdoor, allowed unauthorized withdrawal of funds. The exact vulnerable function and deployed code revision were not independently verified.
